question: Should OpenClaw accept `currentTokenCount` and these SDK token-budget helpers as a stable public ContextEngine/plugin SDK contract now, or fold token headroom into the broader assemble metadata work tracked by #82137?
rationale: The patch changes public plugin API shape and SDK exports while a broader maintainer-visible assemble metadata RFC is still open, so automation cannot choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
options.body: Approve `currentTokenCount` now, then require real behavior proof plus SDK baseline and docs-map regeneration before merge.

options.title: Fold Into RFC #82137
options.body: Pause or close this PR and handle token headroom with the broader provenance/internal-event assemble metadata design.

options.title: Keep Helpers Private For Now
options.body: Avoid new SDK exports until maintainers settle the stable helper surface and compatibility plan.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
recommendation.body: Approve `currentTokenCount` now, then require real behavior proof plus SDK baseline and docs-map regeneration before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and have the most recent merged history on the same context-engine assemble budgeting path.
